spec.source:
---
config:
  gantt:
    barHeight: 6
---
gantt
  dateFormat HHmm
  axisFormat %H:%M
  section service_id FULLW
    AB1, route 10 (no service) :done, ab1, 0800, 0810
    AB2, route 10 (no service) :done, ab2, 1205, 1215
    BFC1, route 20 (no service) :done, bfc1, 0820, 0920
    BFC2, route 20 (no service) :done, bfc2, 1100, 1200
    STBA, route 30 every 30 min (no service) :done, stba, 0600, 2200
    CITY1, route 40 every 10 or 30 min (no service) :done, city1, 0600, 2200
    CITY2, route 40 every 10 or 30 min (no service) :done, city2, 0600, 2200
  section service_id WE
    AAMV1, route 50 (no service) :done, aamv1, 0800, 0900
    AAMV2, route 50 (no service) :done, aamv2, 1000, 1100
    AAMV3, route 50 (no service) :done, aamv3, 1300, 1400
    AAMV4, route 50 (no service) :done, aamv4, 1500, 1600

nodes.label: CITY1, route 40 every 10 or 30 min (no service)
CITY2, route 40 every 10 or 30 min (no service)
